parrafo_1.es: Bernardo y Emmanuel Nunes fundaron Nunes 4 Flooring Corp en 2022 como un negocio familiar en Jacksonville, FL. Instalan madera, laminado, vinilo de lujo y cerámica, y remodelan cocinas y baños completos, sin subcontratar el trabajo a terceros.
parrafo_1.en: Bernardo and Emmanuel Nunes founded Nunes 4 Flooring Corp in 2022 as a family-owned business in Jacksonville, FL. They install hardwood, laminate, luxury vinyl plank and tile flooring, and remodel full kitchens and bathrooms, without subcontracting the work out.

parrafo_2.es: Licenciados, asegurados y reconocidos como Google Guaranteed, fueron clasificados #1 entre 254 contratistas de pisos en Jacksonville, FL por ContractorsRanked. Más de un millón de pies cuadrados de piso instalados, y la calificación de 5.0 en Google con 138 reseñas lo confirma.
parrafo_2.en: Licensed, insured and recognized as Google Guaranteed, they were ranked #1 among 254 flooring contractors in Jacksonville, FL by ContractorsRanked. Over one million square feet of flooring installed, and the 5.0 rating on Google with 138 reviews backs it up.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué piso quieres cambiar: cocina, baño, sala o escaleras. Respondemos al (904) 479-1447.
texto.en: Tell us what floor you want changed: kitchen, bathroom, living room or stairs. We answer at (904) 479-1447.

texto.es: Vamos a tu casa, te mostramos muestras reales de material y te damos un precio claro antes de empezar.
texto.en: We come to your home, show you real material samples and give you a clear price before starting.

texto.es: No subcontratamos: el mismo equipo que cotiza es el que instala, con los materiales correctos para cada espacio.
texto.en: We don't subcontract: the same crew that quotes the job installs it, with the right materials for every space.

titulo.es: Piso terminado y listo para vivir
titulo.en: Finished floor, ready to live on

texto.es: Dejamos el área limpia y el piso listo para que te mudes o sigas con tu día, muchas veces en pocos días.
texto.en: We leave the area clean and the floor ready for you to move in or get on with your day, often in just a few days.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza según el material, el metraje y el estado del piso actual. Llámanos y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on material, square footage and the condition of the existing floor. Call us and we will give you a price, no strings attached.

texto.es: Pisos impermeables para cocina, baño y toda la casa, con la apariencia de madera real y sin preocuparte por el agua.
texto.en: Waterproof floors for kitchens, bathrooms and the whole house, with the look of real wood and none of the worry about water.

texto.es: Madera clásica y atemporal, instalada o pegada directo al concreto, con el tono y acabado que combine con tu casa.
texto.en: Classic, timeless hardwood, nail-down or glued directly to the slab, finished in the tone that fits your home.

texto.es: Porcelanato, piedra y mosaico para baños, cocinas y duchas, incluyendo trabajos a la medida como nichos y bancas.
texto.en: Porcelain, stone and mosaic for bathrooms, kitchens and showers, including custom work like niches and benches.

texto.es: Una opción duradera y accesible para renovar el piso de toda la casa sin salirte del presupuesto.
texto.en: A durable, budget-friendly option to update the flooring in your whole home without blowing the budget.

pie.es: También remodelamos cocinas y baños completos, e instalamos y renovamos escaleras. Pregúntanos, si tiene que ver con tu piso, es trabajo para nosotros.
pie.en: We also remodel full kitchens and bathrooms, and install and refinish stairs. Ask us anyway, if it has to do with your floor, it is our kind of job.

items.quote: This company did absolutely beautiful work and such a short amount of time! They were able to do five rooms of tile which included carpet removal within three days so we could move into our new home.
Nunes 4Flooring Co. recently updated the downstairs of our home from carpet to hardwood, and our fireplace and we have not stopped raving about their incredible service to our friends and neighbors.
We quoted several flooring places and found Nunes 4 Flooring Corp to be the best by far in price, clarity of quote and quality of flooring. These guys don't subcontract out the work.
